name: optcatalog_can_spawn_through_ray
description: OptCatalog::CanSpawnThroughRay classifies a ray hit as blocked, reflected continuation, or no continuation while reporting ray lengths and optional capture positions.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0ba0 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRaycastHitEntry*, stack arguments for rayStart, rayEnd, rayLengthOut, reflectedLengthOut, and reflectedDirOut, ray length from hit position to start, zero-length return 2, damage-handler blocked return 0 with optional capture snapshots, reflection gated by entry flag bit 0, and reflected direction normalization length output.
The native smoke verifies reflected continuation, blocked/captured hit behavior, and zero-length no-continuation behavior.
